exact_theorem.coordinate_lower_bound: ||D_I||_(2->2)>=||D_I e_t||_2 for every unit coordinate e_t
exact_theorem.finite_scope: the inequalities are exact; ratios and rows are finite audits
exact_theorem.mask_hit_column_formula: D_I e_t=-sum_{p|t}e_p R_I K_p e_t +sum_{p not|t}e_p R_I(P_p-I)K_p e_t
exact_theorem.selector: J_I={t in I: exists active shell prime p with p|t}

protocol.physical_entry: 1_(u!=t)1_(p does not divide u t)p h_s(u-t) (1_(p divides u-t)-1/(p-1))
protocol.witness_selector: argmax_{t in J_I} ||D_I e_t||_2; first-hit also stored
protocol.witness_set: J_I={t in I: exists p in shell(q), p divides t}
